name: Midnight Silk Abaya
description: A timeless masterpiece crafted from pure mulberry silk. The Midnight Silk Abaya drapes beautifully with a fluid silhouette, featuring delicate hand-stitched gold thread detailing along the cuffs and neckline. Perfect for evening gatherings and special occasions.
careInstructions: Iron on low heat with silk setting

name: Pearl Embellished Abaya
description: Adorned with hand-sewn freshwater pearls cascading along the front panel, this abaya is the epitome of refined elegance. The premium crepe fabric ensures a structured yet comfortable fit, making it ideal for weddings and formal celebrations.

name: Everyday Linen Abaya
description: Effortlessly chic for daily wear, this linen abaya offers breathable comfort in Qatar's warm climate. The relaxed A-line cut provides ease of movement, while the minimalist design speaks to understated sophistication.
careInstructions: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle

name: Golden Hour Kimono Abaya
description: Inspired by the warm hues of a Doha sunset, this kimono-style abaya features wide sleeves with gold geometric embroidery. The open-front design allows versatile styling — wear it as an outer layer or belted at the waist.

name: Minimalist Crepe Abaya
description: The foundation of every modern wardrobe. This clean-lined crepe abaya is designed for the woman who values simplicity without compromise. Subtle princess seams create a flattering shape, while the matte crepe fabric resists wrinkles beautifully.

name: Crystal Lattice Abaya
description: A show-stopping piece featuring an intricate lattice pattern of Swarovski crystals across the bodice and sleeves. This haute couture abaya is designed for the most distinguished occasions, offering unparalleled glamour with modest grace.

name: Desert Rose Abaya
description: Celebrating the beauty of the Arabian desert, this abaya features a subtle rose-toned undertone with hand-embroidered floral motifs along the hemline. The lightweight fabric makes it ideal for transitional seasons.

name: Travel-Friendly Jersey Abaya
description: Your perfect travel companion. This wrinkle-resistant jersey abaya packs beautifully and maintains its shape throughout the day. The stretchy fabric provides ultimate comfort for long flights and busy travel days.
careInstructions: Hang dry or tumble dry low

name: Royal Velvet Abaya
description: Crafted from sumptuous Italian velvet, this abaya exudes regal sophistication. The rich texture catches light beautifully, while the structured shoulders and tapered sleeves create a modern, polished silhouette.

name: Summer Breeze Abaya
description: Designed for the warmest days, this airy cotton-blend abaya features a relaxed butterfly cut that allows maximum airflow. The subtle texture adds visual interest while maintaining an effortlessly elegant look.

name: Calligraphy Art Abaya
description: A wearable work of art featuring hand-painted Arabic calligraphy along the back panel. Each piece is unique, with the calligraphy depicting verses celebrating beauty and grace. A true collector's piece for the discerning woman.
careInstructions: Do not iron directly on calligraphy

name: Modern Cape Abaya
description: Redefining modern modest fashion, this cape-style abaya features an attached flowing cape that creates a dramatic yet graceful movement. The dual-layer design adds dimension while maintaining a streamlined silhouette underneath.
careInstructions: Hang on wide hanger to preserve cape shape
